summary: Discussion-era signals show major vendor agent releases (Google Gemini, Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI), several operational/verification pain points (code-review bottleneck, sandbox escapes, credential-stealing PyPI), and new startups/infra for running and securing coding agents. | Vendor-only shard: major vendor agent/platform updates (Microsoft Foundry, OpenAI risk docs, AWS customer ops), infra primitives for sandboxes/identity, and high-severity security advisories. | GitHub OSS snapshot: several vendor releases (Google Gemini CLI, Vercel AI SDK, Anthropic Claude Code) plus high-profile agent frameworks and operator tooling. Lots of repo-only signals needing corroboration and missing social/operator discussion coverage. | Packages snapshot: mix of agent runtimes, high-download VS Code agent extension, security plugins, eval tooling, and MCP/memory pieces. No social/user-workflow posts in this shard; need discussion signals for operator impact.
